title: Something
feel: Slow, about 66 bpm (estimate); bridge in A

sections.name: Verse
sections.note: Commonly played one chord per bar: C Cmaj7 C7 F D G.

sections.name: Refrain
sections.bars: Am | Am(maj7)/G# | Am/G | D9/F# | F Eb G | C

sections.name: Bridge
sections.bars: A | C#m/G# | F#m | A/E | D | G | A
sections.note: Led in by F E♭ G.

sections.name: Bridge, 2nd time
sections.bars: A | C#m/G# | F#m | A/E | D | G | C

why: **Two line clichés** (C–Cmaj7–C7 and Am–Am(maj7)–Am/G–D9/F♯), ♭III, and an augmented sound hidden in Am(maj7)/G♯.
hard_change: **D9/F♯ → F → E♭ → G** within two bars. The Am fingers stay for the whole cliché; only the bass note moves.
theory: C7 = V/IV, D = V/V, E♭ = ♭III (borrowed). The bridge moves to A via G (♭VII).
steps: Changes alone, slowly: the descending bass A–G♯–G–F♯ under the held Am shape.
With the record (the third verse is the guitar solo; the outro follows the record).
